title: Grandmother & Boy on Sidewalk, 1940s Vintage Black & White Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot from the 1940s showing a grandmother standing next to her young grandson on a sidewalk in a quiet residential neighborhood. The front margin features the handwritten caption 'Grandma & Dick at 2 1/2 yrs'. The background displays early to mid-20th century American suburban houses and prominent wooden utility poles, capturing everyday domestic life during the era.
